do.en: Check your faculty and programme’s AI instructions.
do.zh: 先查看本学院和项目的AI规定。

do.en: Explain how GenAI contributed to your learning or work.
do.zh: 说明生成式AI参与学习或作业的具体方式。

dont.en: Do not assume a central framework permits AI in every assessment.
dont.zh: 不要将中央框架理解为所有考核均允许使用AI。

dont.zh: 不要仅凭工具名称推定课程许可或数据保护承诺。

cl-university-of-amsterdam-institutional.text: UvA AI Chat is listed for University of Amsterdam in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: allowed. Derived endorsement type: institutional ai service.

evidence.quote: Vanaf 1 september stelt de Universiteit van Amsterdam (UvA) een eigen AI Chat beschikbaar: UvA AI Chat. De UvA zegt dat deze speciaal is ontwikkeld voor veilig experimenteren met GenAI in het onderwijs en een zelf ontwikkelde GenAI-tool op deze schaal beschikbaar stelt. De tekst zegt dat gedeelde gegevens binnen de technische infrastructuur van de UvA blijven, maar specificeert niet dat de runtime door UvA wordt gehost.

uva-claim-001.text: The University of Amsterdam has a policy framework for Generative AI in education that provides central guidelines for responsible use of GenAI based on scientific integrity, with room for faculties and programmes to translate the policy into their own educational practice.

evidence.quote: The policy framework contains general and specific guidelines for the responsible use of GenAI in education. At the same time, it offers faculties and programmes room to translate the policy into their own educational practice. After all, GenAI requires customization: the impact and proper application differs per discipline.
evidence.location: Main content section

uva-claim-004.text: At the UvA, both the Netherlands Code of Conduct for Research Integrity and the European Code of Conduct for Research Integrity apply, which outline the principles and standards for integrity in research and teaching.

evidence.quote: At the UvA, both the Netherlands Code of Conduct for Research Integrity and the European Code of Conduct for Research Integrity apply. These outline the principles and standards for integrity in research and teaching.
evidence.location: Codes of conduct for research integrity section

uva-claim-002.text: The University of Amsterdam is developing its own AI chat environment called UvA AI Chat, which is similar to ChatGPT but is fully self-managed and specifically designed for UvA students, lecturers and staff.

evidence.quote: The UvA is developing its own AI chat environment: the UvA AI Chat. This application is similar to ChatGPT but is fully self-managed and specifically designed for UvA students, lecturers and staff.
evidence.location: UvA AI Chat section

uva-claim-003.text: The UvA and VU task force on AI in education has produced criteria for software to ensure academic integrity, and expects students to be transparent about how they have applied generative AI in their own learning and work.

evidence.quote: The UvA and VU draw up clear rules and guidelines on how students may use AI during teaching and assessment. We expect students to be transparent about how they have applied generative AI in their own learning and work.
evidence.location: Transparent about expectations section
